scope: Publicly observable ESXi DirectPath capability behavior in an authorized nested lab; no private implementation inference

classCodeMatrix.acceptanceLayer: Host static passthruCapable only; the deliberately class/header-mismatched variants were not assigned to an L3 guest
classCodeMatrix.inference: A blanket denylist keyed only by the tested CPU, memory, host-bridge, or PCI-bridge class codes is disproven for Type-0 assignable endpoints.

type1BridgeFlr.inference: A recognized FLR reset path is not sufficient for a real Type-1 fabric bridge. Structural bridge role is an eligibility gate separate from both class code and reset method.

publicPolicyBoundary.compatibilityGuide: Support qualification boundary; not equivalent to the observed runtime passthruCapable gate
publicPolicyBoundary.passthruMap: VID:DID-wildcard reset-method and fptShareable quirk map; the cited public format has no generic deny action
publicPolicyBoundary.remainingUnknown: These experiments do not disprove undisclosed product-specific deny policy or HCL/driver restrictions for physical hardware
